product.ta-alphatronic-p60-1.summary: The P60-1 paired a diskette drive with a hard disk in the Alphatronic office range.
product.ta-alphatronic-p60-1.history: Datamation documented this factory configuration in 1985 alongside the other P50 and P60 variants.
product.ta-alphatronic-p60-1.technical.c: The hard disk let programs stay installed on the workstation. Datamation documents a 12.5 MB Winchester and one 360 KiB drive.
product.ta-alphatronic-p60-1.technical.v: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-alphatronic-p60-1.technical.l: Model-specific firmware and startup verification remain pending.
